grid.layout_notes: Official specs: 5×5 Video Slot / Avalanche Cluster Pays on a 5×5 grid.

win_system.notes: Official Paylines field: '5+ cluster pays'. Marketing copy describes Avalanche Cluster Pays; exact minimum cluster size beyond the '5+' label is not further detailed on the product sheet.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Avalanche: winning clusters explode, paving the way for new symbols; sequence can continue for further wins in the same paid round.

other.name: Giant Symbols
other.how_it_works: Giant Symbols can land on the grid for larger payouts (listed under Bonus Features; exact size/transform rules not fully specified on the public product sheet).

base_game_loop.summary: 5×5 avalanche cluster slot with a progressive win multiplier that doubles on each win in the sequence; Free Spins keep the multiplier active; studio modes Fast Track / Xtra-Bet / Burst Mode available.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Player spins the 5×5 grid at the selected bet (optional Xtra-Bet increases chance of bonus).

phases.name: Cluster evaluate
phases.what_happens: Winning clusters (5+ cluster pays) are awarded.

phases.name: Progressive multiplier
phases.what_happens: Progressive Win Multiplier DOUBLES with each win in the avalanche sequence.

phases.name: Avalanche
phases.what_happens: Winning clusters explode; new symbols enter; repeat evaluate/multiplier/avalanche while wins continue.

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: If Free Spins Bonus triggers (exact scatter count not on product sheet) or via Fast Track, enter Free Spins where the progressive multiplier remains active throughout.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Cluster wins each avalanche step, scaled by the current progressive multiplier.
base_game_loop.notes: Exact Free Spins trigger count and starting multiplier value are not printed on the public product sheet / game page specs.

wilds.name: Wilds
wilds.behavior: Official page: Wilds enhance chances of victory. Listed under Special Symbols as Wilds.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: Listed under Special Symbols as Bonus (Free Spins Bonus feature). Exact land counts to trigger are not on the public product sheet.

multipliers.name: Progressive Win Multiplier
multipliers.behavior: DOUBLES with each win; remains active throughout Free Spins.

specials.name: Giant Symbols
specials.behavior: Can grace the grid with colossal payouts (product sheet / page feature list).

modes.name: Free Spins Bonus
modes.trigger: Bonus feature trigger (exact symbol count not stated on public product sheet). Fast Track can access bonus features directly.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Progressive Win Multiplier remains active throughout Free Spins.
modes.progressive_state: Multiplier continues doubling with each win during Free Spins.
modes.effects: Free Spins play with the progressive multiplier staying active for the feature, enabling larger chained avalanche wins.

phases.name: Free spin avalanche
phases.what_happens: Resolve cluster wins with avalanches; multiplier doubles per win and persists for the feature.

bonus_free_spins.notes: Public product sheet lists Free Spins Bonus but does not publish spin counts, retrigger, or scatter thresholds — marked unknown rather than invented.

features.name: Progressive Win Multiplier
features.trigger: Each win in an avalanche sequence
features.effects: Multiplier DOUBLES with each win; stays active through Free Spins.

features.name: Giant Symbols
features.effects: Large symbols on the grid for higher payouts.

features.name: Burst Mode
features.effects: Enhanced auto-play completing two game rounds per second.

features.name: Fast Track
features.effects: Access the game’s bonus features directly.
features.cost_text: Cost not stated on public product sheet

features.name: Xtra-Bet
features.effects: Augment bet to increase chance of winning a bonus round.
features.cost_text: Cost multiplier not stated on public product sheet

options.name: Fast Track
options.cost_text: Not stated on public product sheet

feature_buy.notes: Fast Track is the studio bonus-entry product; exact price not on public sheet.

ante_bet.effects: Xtra-Bet augments the bet to increase bonus-round chance.
ante_bet.notes: Exact multiplier not on public product sheet.

numeric_limits.rtp_notes: Product sheet RTP 96.12%. Game page also lists Variant 2: 94.05.
